thread.title_full: Solid debut from White guides RockHounds to 9-4 win over Tulsa

author: Midland Times
title: Solid debut from White guides RockHounds to 9-4 win over Tulsa
text:
Newcomer Tommy White contributed significantly to the Midland RockHounds' 9-4 victory over the Tulsa Drillers in his Double-A debut. White, recently assigned from the High-A Lansing Lugnuts, hit two RBI singles and scored a run during the game.
According to reports, White's first hit for Midland followed an RBI double by Junior Perez in the first inning. The RockHounds initially led 2-0, but Tulsa responded with a run in the second inning and added two more in the fourth, taking a 3-2 lead.
The RockHounds equalized at 3-3 in the bottom of the fourth before rallying for four runs in the fifth inning. Nate Nankil's single and a pickoff error at first base set up White's second RBI single, restoring Midland's lead. With a score of 4-3, two consecutive walks loaded the bases for Midland.
An RBI walk by Luke Mann and an RBI double from Colby Halter extended Midland's advantage to 7-3. In the seventh inning, Brennan Milone added an RBI single to increase their lead to 8-3. Mann's RBI single in the eighth was Midland's final scoring play.
Chen Zhuang was initially scheduled to start but was replaced last minute by Gage Jump, who recorded four strikeouts over two innings. Zhuang later entered as a reliever and achieved three strikeouts across four innings, securing his fifth win.
The series continues tonight at 6:30 p.m., with Zhuang expected to take the mound again.
